title: Trilegal acts on JBM Ecolife Mobility securing ₹750 crore Motilal Oswal
description: JBM Ecolife Mobility Private Limited has secured a hybrid investment on ₹750 crore from Motilal Oswal Alternates through a combination of debt and equity-linked securities.Trilegal advised JBM Auto Limited in connection to this transaction.The Corporate Team advising on the matter was led by Vaibhav Kothari (Partner) and Tanya Nanda (Partner); and supported by Mayank Jain (Senior Associate) and Parinishtha Ganz (Associate).The Debt Team advising on the matter was led by Vidhi Sarin (Partner
